title: Compiled Python bytecode tracked: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
detail: Build artifact committed in tree next to the derivation script it shadows; r6 left it untouched.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc; add __pycache__/ to .gitignore (as .pp-settings.bin was).

title: Workflow mirror still broken: ci.yml runs only `odin test core` while local gate 2 runs core + 3x app + render + audio + harness
evidence: ci.yml: '- name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)\n        run: odin test core'  |  ci-local.sh: 'Core unit tests ...|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render ... && odin test app/audio ... && odin test harness ...'
detail: The remote CI that gates PRs skips every r4–r6 pin, including the new effect_settings wiring tests; local-only coverage.
recommended_fix: Copy the gate-2 command (or a gate-indexed runner) into the workflow step so remote CI mirrors local.

title: Harness capture computes crisis banner_y from RAW constants while the app hud-scales it
detail: A second banner-geometry source that ignores ui_scale; the x1.50 a11y_scale golden under-pins real app placement at scaled HUDs.
recommended_fix: Route the capture banner_y through rnd.hud(&rc.view, ...) so harness and app share one geometry.

title: AUDIO row toggles mute but settings_save persists nothing about it — A11y_Settings has no mute byte
evidence:
main.odin effect_settings_adjust: 'case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO:
		au.toggle_mute(&app.audio)
	}
	settings_save(app.a11y)'  |  settings.odin: 'A11y_Settings :: struct {
	palette:       rnd.Palette_Mode,
	reduced_motion: bool,
	scale_step:     u8, ... }'
detail: The effect's comment claims 'Every change lands in the settings file'; the mute resets on relaunch. Comment/code divergence, hidden contract break.
recommended_fix: Add a mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or correct the comment and panel expectations.

title: crisis_card_width hardcodes the forecast panel's 230/10 layout constants
evidence:
forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge
	max_right := forecast_left - hud(v, 10)
detail: Crisis module duplicates forecast-panel geometry literals; resizing the forecast silently breaks the clamp.
recommended_fix: Share named constants (or a forecast_left proc) between forecast.odin and crisis.odin.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps an unscaled nil-view fallback and parity exercises that branch
evidence: popover.odin: 'demolish_button_rect :: proc(pop: rl.Rectangle, v: ^View = nil) -> rl.Rectangle {'
detail: A latent second geometry path the app never draws; parity pins the dead branch instead of the scaled one.
recommended_fix: Require the view (or default to a base View) so parity exercises the production path.
